responsibility: Implements computation and maintenance of dominator and postdominator information for CFGs. It contains GCC’s Lengauer-Tarjan-based dominator algorithm, region-specific and incremental dominator updating, nearest-common-dominator and recomputation helpers, and maintenance of the Euler-tour-tree-backed dominance forest stored in `basic_block::dom`; it produces immediate-dominator relationships, dominance-tree child links, and availability state that loop analysis, SSA construction, CFG threading, and other passes depend on.
same_name_distinction: Implements dominance computation and maintenance algorithms, including Lengauer-Tarjan calculation and Euler-tour-forest-backed updates; dominance.h is the client-facing interface to query and mutate that information.
